entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I pushed open the door and stepped..."
entries.dialogueText: I pushed open the door and stepped into the bustling locker room. The players, clad in their FC Anrica jerseys, all stopped what they were doing and turned their heads to look at me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The team's new manager, Iorgel Glop..."
entries.dialogueText: The team's new manager, Iorgel Gloper, immediately came and shook my hand. He seemed to be under a large amount of stress.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He introduced me to the players and..."
entries.dialogueText: He introduced me to the players and invited me to give a short motivational speech.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good day to all of you, gentlemen.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good day to all of you, gentlemen."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""FC Anrica! Your president stands t..."
entries.dialogueText: "FC Anrica! Your president stands together with you today."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Hello, everybody. I hope you are r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hello, everybody. I hope you are ready for the match of the decade!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's great to be here today among..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's great to be here today among all of you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A hush fell over the room as the pl..."
entries.dialogueText: A hush fell over the room as the players leaned forward, eagerly awaiting my words.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Today, we stand united on this hal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, we stand united on this hallowed ground, representing our nation, our flag, and the hopes of millions."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Today, you have one purpose. You a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, you have one purpose. You are here to win, to show the world the Sordish spirit. And I know that you will succeed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I want you to know that millions a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want you to know that millions are proud of you for reaching this stage in the Merkopan Cup. Regardless of the results, your achievements so far will not be forgotten."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This match is more than a game. It..."
entries.dialogueText: "This match is more than a game. It's an opportunity to showcase the strength, resilience, and spirit of both FC Anrica and the country of Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Every pass, every tackle, every go..."
entries.dialogueText: "Every pass, every tackle, every goal must be executed with the utmost precision, for the eyes of the world and the Sordish people are upon us."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This match is a celebration, an op..."
entries.dialogueText: "This match is a celebration, an opportunity to showcase the true essence of your craft. Let's take a moment to breathe in the electric atmosphere, to soak in the vibrant energy that surrounds you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You have inspired millions of Sord..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have inspired millions of Sordish men and women. Their hopes and dreams rest on what happens in the next 90 minutes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We must push ourselves beyond our..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must push ourselves beyond our limits, embracing discomfort and adversity as catalysts for our growth."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""As you step onto that field, let g..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you step onto that field, let go of any lingering doubts and embrace the sheer joy that comes with playing the game you love dearly."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't want to see any regrets af..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want to see any regrets after the match. You've got to leave everything out there on the field."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Failure is not an option, for it w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Failure is not an option, for it will reverberate through the annals of history. I implore you to dig deep within your souls, find that reservoir of untapped determination, and channel it into every fiber of your being."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Remember, it's not just about the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember, it's not just about the outcome, but the memories we create and the smiles we bring to the faces of our fans."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You are an extraordinary team. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are an extraordinary team. The best in Sordland. Maybe even the best in Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The weight of this moment may feel..."
entries.dialogueText: "The weight of this moment may feel overwhelming, but it is in the crucible of pressure that true champions are forged."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""When the final whistle blows, we w..."
entries.dialogueText: "When the final whistle blows, we want to look back and know that we gave it our all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The match today will not be easy...."
entries.dialogueText: "The match today will not be easy. But neither was the path that led to it. I am proud of each and every one of you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Now, go forth, my fellow Anrican w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, go forth, my fellow Anrican warriors, and leave an indelible mark on this game! I have the utmost faith in your success!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Now take a moment to relax. And do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now take a moment to relax. And don't forget -- win or lose, Sordland is proud of you."

entries.dialogueText: "Long live the Republic and long live Sordland!"

entries.dialogueText: "Just know this... If you fail at this stage, you'll be proving me wrong. Nobody wants that. Are we clear, gentlemen? Are you ready to win?"

entries.dialogueText: The players exchanged puzzled looks for a few seconds before they broke into loud applause.

entries.dialogueText: All of them stood up and yelled "Champion FC Anrica!"

entries.title: Narrator: "The players exchanged nervous glanc..."
entries.dialogueText: The players exchanged nervous glances. Their captain gestured at them, and they burst into loud applause.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Most of the team shouted back the p..."
entries.dialogueText: Most of the team shouted back the phrase: "Vectern sis da!"

entries.dialogueText: I cast my eyes over the team. The Sordish players were grinning, but others seemed unconvinced.

entries.title: Narrator: "Just then, the legendary Sordish de..."
entries.dialogueText: Just then, the legendary Sordish defender, Captain Bruno Korkmer, came up to me and explained that he and his family had voted for me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He then introduced me to the two ne..."
entries.dialogueText: He then introduced me to the two newest transfers to the team, already considered the star duo of FC Anrica -- the Neqisi midfielder Hsuen Xoqr and the Nibiyan striker Leon al-Ogwaldo.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They both shook my hand and greeted..."
entries.dialogueText: They both shook my hand and greeted me in broken Sordish.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Right after that, the manager signa..."
entries.dialogueText: Right after that, the manager signalled to the players that the match was about to begin. The security staff ushered me back towards the lounge.
